description: Secure filesystem MCP server for reading, writing, searching, diffing, and patching files.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed directories
allowed_directories.description: Directories the server may read and write. Other paths need your approval first.

tool_signatures.name: create
tool_signatures.description: Write whole text files (create new ones, overwrite, or append) or make empty directories. Missing parent directories are created. edit or patch changes part of an existing file.

path.description: Absolute path where the file will be created

append.description: Append the content to the end of the file instead of overwriting; creates the file if it does not exist

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file without asking the user; without it an existing file prompts for confirmation

files.description: List of files to create (max 100); each entry requires path and content; combined content is capped at the file-size limit

items.description: File or directory path inside an allowed workspace root.

directories.description: Empty directories to create, like mkdir -p; one that already exists is left as it is

parameters.name: directories
parameters.description: Empty directories to create, like mkdir -p; one that already exists is left as it is

parameters.name: files
parameters.description: List of files to create (max 100); each entry requires path and content; combined content is capped at the file-size limit

tool_signatures.name: delete
tool_signatures.description: Permanently delete files, directories, or symlinks, like rm or rm -r. Paths are exact; globs are not expanded.

items.description: File or directory path inside an allowed workspace root.

paths.description: Paths to delete (max 1000); accepts files, directories, or symlinks

recursive.description: Delete directory contents recursively (required for non-empty directories)

ignoreIfNotExists.description: Silently succeed if a path does not exist instead of returning an error

parameters.name: ignoreIfNotExists
parameters.description: Silently succeed if a path does not exist instead of returning an error

parameters.name: paths
parameters.description: Paths to delete (max 1000); accepts files, directories, or symlinks

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: Delete directory contents recursively (required for non-empty directories)

tool_signatures.name: diff
tool_signatures.description: Compare two text files and return a unified diff from a to b, like diff -u.

context.description: Number of context lines surrounding each change (default: 3)

parameters.name: a
parameters.description: First file to compare

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: Second file to compare

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Number of context lines surrounding each change (default: 3)

tool_signatures.name: edit
tool_signatures.description: Edit text files in place by replacing exact oldText with newText, like str_replace. Each oldText must match exactly once, and a file is written only if all its edits match. replace_text replaces every occurrence across files.

path.description: Single file path; mutually exclusive with files

newText.description: Replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the matched oldText.

oldText.description: Exact literal text to locate in the file; it must match exactly once. Include 3-5 lines of context so it does — an oldText found in several places fails with their line numbers.

edits.description: Replacements applied to path (required with path); not allowed with files

path.description: File or directory path inside an allowed workspace root.

newText.description: Replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the matched oldText.

oldText.description: Exact literal text to locate in the file; it must match exactly once. Include 3-5 lines of context so it does — an oldText found in several places fails with their line numbers.

edits.description: Replacements to apply to this specific file

dryRun.description: Preview diffs without writing to disk (default: false = apply edits)

ignoreWhitespace.description: Ignore leading/trailing whitespace differences when matching oldText

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: Preview diffs without writing to disk (default: false = apply edits)

parameters.name: files

parameters.name: ignoreWhitespace

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Single file path; mutually exclusive with files

tool_signatures.name: find_files
tool_signatures.description: Find files by name or glob pattern; returns file paths relative to the root, ready to pass to read or edit. A pattern without / matches file names at any depth. search_text searches contents.

path.description: Base directory to search under (default: first allowed root)

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor; pass unchanged for the next page. Pages slice one snapshot taken on the first call; it expires after ~60s — re-request without a cursor if rejected.

sortBy.description: Sort order: path = full path (default), name = basename only

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths (e.g. **/*.ts, src/**/*.js)

maxDepth.description: Max directory depth to scan; 0 = base directory only, omit for unlimited

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching files to return per page

parameters.name: includeIgnored
parameters.description: Include ignored items (node_modules, .git, etc).

tool_signatures.name: list
tool_signatures.description: List a directory's files and subdirectories as a tree of names, like ls or tree. includeSizes adds sizes and a total; stat returns dates.

path.description: Directory to list (default: first allowed root)

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor; pass unchanged for the next page. Pages slice one snapshot taken on the first call; it expires after ~60s — re-request without a cursor if rejected.

sortBy.description: Order within each directory: name (default) or size (largest first)

maxDepth.description: Max directory depth to traverse (default: 1 = top-level only; increase to recurse deeper)

maxEntries.description: Page size (default: 1000). Continue with nextCursor; an incomplete first page also carries resourceUri for the whole list.

includeSizes.description: Show file sizes in the tree and a totals line of counts and bytes

tool_signatures.name: list_roots
tool_signatures.description: List the directories this server can access, as absolute paths, including any the user granted during this session. Other tools can ask the user to grant access to a path outside them.

tool_signatures.name: move
tool_signatures.description: Move, rename, or copy files and directories, like mv or cp -r. Each destination is the full new path, not a folder to move into; missing parent directories are created.

copy.description: Copy instead of move; sources are left in place

source.description: Path of the file or directory to move or copy

overwrite.description: Copy mode only: overwrite existing destinations without confirmation

parameters.name: copy

parameters.name: moves
parameters.description: Operations to perform (max 100)

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.description: Copy mode only: overwrite existing destinations without confirmation

tool_signatures.name: patch
tool_signatures.description: Apply a single-file unified diff to one existing text file, like git apply. Nothing is written unless every hunk applies in file order with exactly matching context; hunks are found by their context, so start line numbers may be off.

diff.description: Single-file unified diff to apply (as produced by the diff tool or edit dry-run)

path.description: File to apply the diff to

dryRun.description: Preview the result without writing (default: false)

parameters.name: diff
parameters.description: Single-file unified diff to apply (as produced by the diff tool or edit dry-run)

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: Preview the result without writing (default: false)

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: File to apply the diff to

tool_signatures.name: read
tool_signatures.description: Read text files, like cat: whole, or one slice via head, tail, or startLine/endLine. Images and audio return as media; pass binary: true to get any other binary file whole as a base64 embedded resource.

path.description: Single file path; mutually exclusive with paths

items.description: File or directory path inside an allowed workspace root.

paths.description: Array of file paths for batch mode (max 1000); mutually exclusive with path

binary.description: Return a binary file that is not an image or audio whole, as a base64 embedded resource. Full reads only.

includeHash.description: Include SHA-256 hash of the returned content in the response

parameters.description: Start line (1-indexed)

parameters.description: Return last N lines

tool_signatures.name: replace_text
tool_signatures.description: Find and replace every occurrence of literal text or an RE2 regex, like sed -i, in one file or all files under a directory, optionally filtered by glob. The pattern runs over the whole file: it can span lines, and ^ and $ anchor to file start and end. edit replaces one unique exact match.

path.description: File to rewrite, or directory to rewrite under. Omitting it targets the ENTIRE first allowed root — scope it deliberately, and pair a wide scope with dryRun=true first

dryRun.description: Preview replacements without writing to disk (default: false = apply changes)

isRegex.description: Treat searchPattern as a RE2 regex (default: literal text match)

pattern.description: Glob to restrict replacements to specific file types (e.g. **/*.ts); default: all text files

maxDepth.description: Max directory depth to scan; 0 = base directory only, omit for unlimited

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to process

wholeWord.description: Match whole words only (word boundary anchoring)

maxResults.description: Maximum total match count across all files before stopping

returnDiff.description: Include a unified diff of all changes in the response

replacement.description: Replacement text. Use capture group references ($1, $2, etc.) when isRegex=true. Use an empty string to delete all matches.

searchPattern.description: Exact literal text or RE2 regex pattern to search for. When isRegex=true, uses RE2 syntax (no lookahead, lookbehind, or backreferences are supported). Cannot be empty or whitespace-only.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of matching lines to return per page

searchPattern.description: Exact literal text or RE2 regex pattern to search for in file contents. When isRegex=true, uses RE2 syntax (no lookahead, lookbehind, or backreferences). Cannot be empty or whitespace-only.

Also checks whether paths exist.
